close_reason: Rustdoc 'Errors' section added covering: Err = genuine storage/runtime failure → method-level serverFail via server_fail_from_backend (no Self::Error Display leak); malformed-but-readable blobs → not_parsable; unknown blob ids → not_found. Bundled with JMAP-ic0j.66 since both findings target the same rustdoc.
description:
crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/backend.rs:521-542 defines `parse_calendar_event_blobs(...) -> Result<ParseResult, Self::Error>` with rustdoc describing only the `Ok` shape and the default impl behavior.

The rustdoc says NOTHING about what happens when the backend returns `Err(Self::Error)`. Possible interpretations a backend implementor could read into the type:

1. The error propagates up as a method-level `serverFail` (correct, but unstated).
2. The error gets swallowed and ALL the blob ids land in `not_parsable` (legitimate if the backend wants to be permissive).
3. The error aborts the request entirely (incorrect — `not_found` / `not_parsable` were designed for this).

Compare `set_default_calendar` in the SAME FILE at :486-488 which EXPLICITLY documents:

> `Err` is reserved for genuine backend storage failures. The handler silently swallows storage errors per §4.3 ("No error is returned to the client in this case") rather than escalating to `serverFail`.

`parse_calendar_event_blobs` has no such clause. The implementation in event.rs:994-1003 (the handler call site) treats `Err` as `server_fail_from_backend(&e)` — so the de-facto contract is "propagates as serverFail" — but this is not stated in the trait method's rustdoc.

What callers cannot rely on:
- Whether they should classify "blob exists but is malformed" as `notParsable` (data classification) or `Err` (storage failure). Reasonable backends could disagree.
- Whether the handler will swallow the error or surface it. They can read event.rs:994 to find out today, but the trait method is the contract surface.

Fix: add a 2-line `# Errors` section to the rustdoc:

    # Errors
    Returns `Err` for genuine backend storage failures (connectivity loss,
    serialisation corruption). Malformed-but-readable blobs go in
    `not_parsable`; unknown blob ids go in `not_found`. `Err` propagates
    to the client as a method-level `serverFail`.
title: parse_calendar_event_blobs Err(_) propagation contract undocumented; sibling methods document Err semantics
